18127.notes: Indiana tax-lien (certificate) county — not a tax-deed auction. Successful bidders receive a Tax Sale Certificate (lien), not a deed; owners generally have one year to redeem under IC 6-1.1-24/25 before a tax-deed petition path. Local quirk: Porter County Ordinance No. 00-7 restricts distribution of tax-sale results to in-person examination at the Auditor’s office only (no electronic results distribution). Official list advertised three consecutive weeks in Springfield News-Sun; working list also posted on county Tax Sales page (PDF updated periodically — e.g. Apr 21, 2026 list referenced). Bids begin at minimum bid unless court directs otherwise. Full amount + 1.5% poundage due at conclusion of sale (cash or check). Buyer beware; deed prepared after confirmation (~2–4 weeks). Separate RealAuction domain (clark.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov) may list related sheriff sales — confirm current tax-sale format with Sheriff before bidding (937-521-2058 withdrawals contact historically).

37191.notes: North Carolina tax-deed / mortgage-style judicial foreclosure county. Unusual: Wayne County Staff Attorney’s Office (not only outside counsel) conducts sales after Tax Collector referral and title search. Sales generally fourth Wednesday monthly at Wayne County Courthouse, 224 E Walnut St, Goldsboro, 10:00 a.m. (additional dates as needed). Opening bid = delinquent taxes + attorney/filing/service fees + auction costs. Deposit 5% of final price or $750 (greater). 10-day upset at Civil Division of Clerk of Court (919-722-6100). Quitclaim deed AS IS. Contact Staff Attorney 919-705-1971. Eastern NC / Seymour Johnson AFB market.

37191.auctionFrequency: Generally fourth Wednesday of each month at 10:00 a.m., plus case-by-case dates (e.g. Nov 19 2025, Dec 17 2025, Apr 15 2026)
37191.depositRules: Highest bidder deposits 5% of sale price or $750 (whichever greater) at sale. Report of sale to Clerk; 10-day upset window. Upset: raise by 5% or $750 and deposit 5% of new bid or $750 cash/certified to Clerk Civil Division (2nd floor courthouse). After upset periods end, balance due within 10 days of confirmation. Failure to fund forfeits all deposits. Redemption by owner/lienholder anytime before completion by paying taxes+fees+costs. Notices in Goldsboro News-Argus 2 weeks + courthouse post ≥20 days.
